cs.t: I've found that the "dedicated" split keyboards don't necessarily have a comfortable distance in the split.  The two keyboards end up about about a body width apart especially if I use a standing desk. These days I use an old M4-1 keyboard (first gen thinkpad keyboard / trackpoint in a standalone keyboard) because I just don't type as much as I used to and I value the desk space.
cs.th: Ask HN: What lesser-known accessories do you use with your computer?
